reason: As someone who lost money on an unfulfilled campaign, Document B wins me over with concrete commitments that directly address my fears about first-time creators: bi-weekly updates, a full refund if delivery is more than three months late, no scope-creeping stretch goals, and an upcoming independent review. However, Document A handles the leftover $2,650 more honestly by calling it a buffer rather than inventing freight and import figures not in the facts.
